description.value: Pho Spot is a Vietnamese restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver with a broad menu spanning pho, vermicelli bowls, rice plates, Vietnamese subs, and appetizers. It features a dedicated vegetarian section with plant-based versions of its noodle soups and rolls. Online pickup ordering is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through North Vancouver.
